name: Mādhava
description: Madhava's 14th-century infinite series for π, and the Kerala correction terms that make it converge astonishingly fast.
aria: A twisting chain of light whose links are the terms of Madhava's series for pi
intro: In 14th-century Kerala, Mādhava wrote π as an infinite sum, then found how to correct the last term so a few dozen terms give eleven digits. Watch the series fold into π.
